factor_diagnostics.value_notes: NOAA reports adult bocaccio primarily in rocky habitat at 130-980 feet (about 40-299 m), while WDFW reports a broad 20-475 m range and greatest abundance around 95-225 m. Juveniles settle in shallower nearshore rocky/kelp habitat and move deeper as they mature; adults can also be midwater. This supports depth as a habitat dimension but does not validate the configured 20-200 m range or 22-195 m ideal across life stages.
